verses.verse:
षष्ठांशे द्वितीये तु भागें भागत्रयम् मतम्।।
निषादौ द्वौ तथा षड्जः स्थाप्यन्ताम् क्रम पूर्वकम्।52।
verses.text: The second sixth is held to have three parts; there let the two Niṣādas and Ṣaḍja be placed in order.

commentary.text: Divide the second ṣaṣṭhāṃśa (one-sixth) into three parts and place, in order, the 3 notes komal Ni, Ni, Sa at equal distances.
